available.quote: An applicant may be licensed pursuant to this chapter if he demonstrates to the satisfaction of the board that he is licensed or registered under the laws of another state, territory, or jurisdiction of the United States which, in the opinion of the board, imposes substantially the same licensing requirements as this chapter.

requirements.value: Applicant must demonstrate licensure or registration in another state/territory with substantially the same requirements; license must not be currently revoked, suspended, restricted, or on probationary status, and no disciplinary action may be pending.

title_protection.quote: uses in connection with his name the words or letters "GC", "LGC", or uses the title "gene counselor", "genetic associate", "genetic counselor", "genetic consultant", or "licensed genetic counselor", or any other letters, words, or insignia indicating or implying that he is a genetic counselor

scope_protection.quote: A person may not engage in the practice of genetic counseling without a license issued in accordance with this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dividing, transferring, assigning, rebating, or refunding fees received for professional services with a referring person or their associates.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: requests, receives, participates, or engages, directly or indirectly, in the dividing, transferring, assigning, rebating, or refunding of fees received for professional services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing genetic counseling and failing to refer a patient to a licensed medical doctor when the patient's condition was beyond the scope of genetic counseling practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has practiced genetic counseling and failed to refer to a licensed medical doctor a patient whose medical condition should have been determined at the time of evaluation or treatment to be beyond the scope of practice of a genetic counselor

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly aiding, assisting, procuring, or advising a person to practice genetic counseling without a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: knowingly aided, assisted, procured, or advised a person to practice genetic counseling contrary to this chapter or to regulations promulgated by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Denial, revocation, suspension, or restriction of a license to practice genetic counseling in another state for grounds that would also constitute grounds for discipline in SC.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: An act or omission by a licensee causing the denial, revocation, suspension, or restriction of a license to practice genetic counseling in another state is sufficient for the issuance of a formal complaint

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using a false, fraudulent, or forged statement or document, or committing a fraudulent act in obtaining licensure.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: used a false, fraudulent, or forged statement or document or committed a fraudulent, deceitful, or dishonest act or omitted a material fact in obtaining licensure under this article

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license to practice in another state canceled, revoked, suspended, or otherwise disciplined.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has had a license to practice a regulated profession or occupation in another state or jurisdiction canceled, revoked, or suspended or who has otherwise been disciplined

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentionally or knowingly violating or aiding in the violation of the licensing act or regulations.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has intentionally or knowingly, directly or indirectly, violated or has aided or abetted in the violation or conspiracy to violate this article or a regulation promulgated under this article

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentionally using a fraudulent statement in a document connected with professional practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has intentionally used a fraudulent statement in a document connected with the practice of the individual's profession or occupation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining fees or assisting in obtaining fees under fraudulent circumstances.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has obtained fees or assisted in obtaining fees under fraudulent circumstances

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing a dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional act likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has committed a dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional act that is likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Lacking the professional or ethical competence to practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: lacks the professional or ethical competence to practice the profession or occupation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of or guilty plea to a felony or a crime involving drugs or moral turpitude.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has been convicted of or has pled guilty to or nolo contendere to a felony or a crime involving drugs or moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing the profession while under the influence of alcohol or drugs, or using them to such a degree as to render the licensee unfit to practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has practiced the profession or occupation while under the influence of alcohol or drugs or uses alcohol or drugs to such a degree as to render him unfit to practice his profession or occupation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Sustaining a physical or mental disability which renders further practice dangerous to the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has sustained a physical or mental disability which renders further practice dangerous to the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating the code of professional ethics adopted by the applicable licensing board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violates the code of professional ethics adopted by the applicable licensing board for the regulated profession or occupation

definition_quote.value: obtain and evaluate individual, family, and medical histories to determine genetic risk for genetic/medical conditions and diseases in a patient, his offspring, and other family members; discuss the features, natural history, means of diagnosis, genetic and environmental factors, and management of risk for genetic/medical conditions and diseases; identify and order genetic laboratory tests as appropriate for the genetic assessment; integrate genetic laboratory test results and other diagnostic studies with personal and family medical histories to assess and communicate risk factors for genetic/medical conditions and diseases; explain the clinical implications of genetic laboratory tests and other diagnostic studies and their results; evaluate responses of the client and his family to the condition or risk of recurrence and provide client-centered counseling and anticipatory guidance; identify and use community resources that provide medical, educational, financial, and psychosocial support and advocacy; and provide written documentation of medical, genetic, and counseling information for families and health care professionals.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of genetic counseling" means: (a) obtain and evaluate individual, family, and medical histories to determine genetic risk for genetic/medical conditions and diseases in a patient, his offspring, and other family members
